/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg-i3" parent="legend" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#1F1F1F;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<font for the disclosure for subject-level data discovery; for healthcare reuse, the framework data use agreement (VII.1.1, VII.1.3)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="890" x="16" y="166" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg-i4" parent="legend" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#1F1F1F;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<font style="font-size: 12px"><b>5</b> Data use agreement for each approved request, issued by the Genome EDIC CC; who signs it for the 1+MG Data Holders is open (VII.5.5, VIII.2.1)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="890" x="16" y="206" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg-i5" parent="legend" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#1F1F1F;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<font style="font-size: 12px"><b>6</b> Data processing agreement: the Genome EDIC processes for the User Organisation in the federated SPEs (VIII.2.1)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="890" x="16" y="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg-i6" parent="legend" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#1F1F1F;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<font style="font-size: 12px"><b>7</b> (Sub-)processing agreement: the SPE provider is sub-processor of the Genome EDIC; its role for the technical and organisational measures is open (VIII.2.1, VIII.3.3)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="890" x="16" y="254" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg-i7" parent="legend" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#1F1F1F;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<font style="font-size: 12px">For 1+MG cohort datasets, the Genome EDIC holds the data legally: agreement 2 does not apply, and in agreement 3 the 1+MG Data Host processes for the Genome EDIC.</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="890" x="16" y="294" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
